# Risk & Compliance Audit Report

This document outlines critical tasks related to risk and compliance:

*   Urgent review of legal risks.
*   Review and update of AML detection standards.
*   Urgent monitoring of regulatory changes.
*   Investigation of legal risks based on audit findings.
*   Quarterly updates on regulatory changes.
